consequence.statement: Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update the module path in go.mod and every import statement to the /v2 module paths when updating to v2+.
consequence.remediation: Change go.mod dependencies and all imports to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2. Commit d6c489c7c080a315051301a9d0e4167e1773657e shows an example.

assertion.statement: In Crossplane v2 the Go module paths are now github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2, so Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update its go.mod module paths and every import statement when moving to v2+.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on whether Go source code or go.mod files import crossplane or crossplane-runtime. None of the available predicates (Helm values, manifests, flags, images) can read that.
